title: Cumulative Layout Shift
definition: CLS measures visual stability. It calculates a score based on how much elements unexpectedly shift around on the screen during the lifespan of the page, usually caused by images loading without explicit dimensions.
simpleExplanation: You go to tap a button, but a massive ad suddenly loads at the top of the page, pushing the button down, and you accidentally tap the wrong link. That's a terrible CLS.
